Bash(python3 << 'EOF'
import re

with open\('dist/de-de/404/index.html', 'r'\) as f:
    html = f.read\(\)

# Find the capri link and its context
match = re.search\(r'.{500}amalfikueste/capri/.{500}', html\)
if match:
    text = match.group\(\)
    # Find the opening tag before capri
    opening = re.search\(r'<[^>]*>\\s*\(?:.*\\n\)*.*amalfikueste/capri', text\)
    print\("Context around capri link:"\)
    print\(text[max\(0, text.rfind\('<', 0, text.find\('amalfikueste/capri'\)\)-100\):text.find\('amalfikueste/capri'\)+150]\)
EOF)

Bash(python3 << 'EOF'
import re

with open\('dist/de-de/404/index.html', 'r', encoding='utf-8'\) as f:
    html = f.read\(\)

# Find position of capri
pos = html.find\('amalfikueste/capri/'\)
if pos > -1:
    # Get 500 chars before and 500 after
    start = max\(0, pos - 500\)
    end = min\(len\(html\), pos + 500\)
    snippet = html[start:end]
    print\(snippet\)
EOF)
